checkedAlternates.risk: Tuscan is one of the five classical orders.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Tuscan was developed in Roman/Renaissance theory (group-1), distinct from the three canonical Greek orders (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Pointed Arch is an arch form.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Pointed arches are a defining structural hallmark of Gothic architecture (group-4), whereas keystone and voussoir are individual masonry stones (group-2).
